formulas.formula: Save for the keys to your first (or next) home.
Home Goal: the price you're aiming for, your down payment %, closing costs and a target date.
Home Goal: add what you've already saved and what you can save each month.
Log: every deposit, withdrawal and interest payment.
Dashboard: saved, left to go, what you need each month, and the date you'll be ready.
Price Scenarios: cash needed at different prices and down payments.
Affordability: what price fits your income (28/36 rule) and an estimated monthly payment.
Usually 2% to 5% of the price. 3% is a fair guess.
Keep some savings after closing for repairs and surprises.
Avoids PMI on most loans. Less down is fine, it just costs more each month.
Keep the fund in high-yield savings and log the interest.
Red means something needs a look.
Home sweet home is on its way.
=IF('Home Goal'!$R$7="","My",'Home Goal'!$R$7)&" home fund  |  "&TEXT('Home Goal'!$R$6,"mmm d, yyyy")
=IF(R4=0,0,IF('Home Goal'!$R$16<=0,"",IF('Home Goal'!$R$15=0,ROUNDUP(R4/'Home Goal'!$R$16,0),ROUNDUP(NPER('Home Goal'!$R$15,-'Home Goal'!$R$16,-MAX(0,'Home Goal'!$R$20),'Home Goal'!$R$19),0))))
=REPT("█",ROUND(MIN(1,MAX(0,R5))*10,0))&REPT("░",10-ROUND(MIN(1,MAX(0,R5))*10,0))&"  "&TEXT(R5,"0%")&" of the way to your new home"

=IF('Home Goal'!$R$19<=0,"Set your home price on the Home Goal tab.",IF(R4=0,"You have it all. Time to call a lender!",IF('Home Goal'!$R$14="","Set a target date to see if you are on track.",IF(R6="","Add a monthly plan to see your ready date.",IF(R7<='Home Goal'!$R$14,"On track. Your plan gets you there by your target date.","Behind. Save "&TEXT(MAX(0,'Home Goal'!$C$28-'Home Goal'!$R$16),"$#,##0")&" more a month to hit your date.")))))
What you can add each month.
Every move in or out. Amounts are always positive; the Type says which way.
Cash needed (down payment + closing + moving + cushion). Green = you have it now.
Months away at your monthly plan (with interest)
